name: Workbench Confirmation Popover
description: Keeps contextual destructive confirmation near its invoking pointer or menu item without introducing a page-wide scrim.

states: Open a Project or Workspace action menu, choose its destructive command, and inspect the confirmation beside the selected menu position.
Cancel with Escape or the visible Cancel action, then reopen and confirm with Enter or the destructive action.

useWhen: A contextual command needs a short confirmation before an immediate destructive or elevated action.
The invoking menu or pointer supplies a stable viewport anchor and the user should not travel to a centered modal.
avoidWhen: The decision has no contextual anchor or must block attention across the entire application.
The workflow contains editable fields, multiple steps, or content too large for a compact anchored surface.
invariants: The confirmation stays anchored near the invoking pointer or menu item and applies no page-wide backdrop.
Title and description identify the exact consequence before the destructive action.
Cancel and confirm expose visible keyboard hints, support Escape and Enter, and settle the pending Action exactly once.
Missing anchor information falls back to the shared modal alert-dialog confirmation pattern.
